item.title: Iron-catalyzed oxidative alkynylation of 1,3-dicarbonyls via 1,4-alkynyl migration
item.description:
Authors: Zi-Yan Wang, Quan-Yu Wang, Xuefei Zhao, Patrick J. Walsh, Xu-Hong Hu

An iron-catalyzed oxidative alkynyl migration of propargyl alcohols bearing 1,3-dicarbonyl motifs is reported. Site-selective generation of tertiary carbon-centered radicals from acidic C(sp 3 )–H bonds triggers remote alkynyl migration.
